sources.entry: Tigase - XMPP server implementation in Java. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Java

summary.one_liner: Tigase XMPP Server is a Java-based, modular XMPP/Jabber server that supports client, server-to-server and component connections.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the main source code of the Tigase XMPP Server, a Java XMPP/Jabber server. The README states support for RFC 6120 (XMPP Core), RFC 6121 (XMPP IM) and RFC 7395 (XMPP over WebSockets), with client connections over TCP, HTTP/HTTPS (BOSH) and WebSockets, plus server-to-server and component connections. It lists many XEPs, including Multi-User Chat (XEP-0045), Publish-Subscribe (XEP-0060), Message Archive Management (XEP-0313), Stream Management (XEP-0198), Message Carbons (XEP-0280) and HTTP File Upload (XEP-0363). It also provides an HTTP API for systems that cannot speak XMPP and support for push notifications to mobile devices. Several addons (MUC, PubSub, MongoDB connector, HTTP API components) are maintained in separate repositories and are mentioned only as related projects.
use_cases: instant messaging for a team or community
push notifications to mobile XMPP clients
XMPP component integration over HTTP API
notable: Modular, extensible architecture with addon components for MUC, PubSub, and message archiving
Supports TCP, BOSH and WebSocket client connections
Built-in HTTP API for integrating non-XMPP services
caveats: Addon components such as MUC, PubSub and MongoDB connector are separate projects, not included in this repository
Documentation and quickstart are distributed with the full server package rather than in this README
Some support channels require a paid support subscription
